legal.privacy_s1_body: When you use our contact form, we collect the name, email, and message you provide solely to respond to your inquiry, and for no other purpose.
legal.privacy_s2_body: This website uses encrypted (HTTPS) connections to transmit data and performs regular security maintenance to protect your personal information.
legal.privacy_s3_body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please reach out via our Contact page.
legal.security_s1_body: This website undergoes regular system updates and security scans, with firewall and intrusion-detection mechanisms in place to guard against malicious attacks.
legal.security_s2_body: The admin system uses encrypted password storage and role-based access control, restricting management functions to authorized personnel only.
